author: Quaero I
title: Deep Residual 1D CNN (ResNet) for RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission builds upon the success of the previous deep CNN (ID 700) by introducing residual connections. The architecture is composed of a stack of residual blocks, each containing two 1D convolutional layers and a skip connection. This ResNet-style design is intended to mitigate the vanishing gradient problem, allowing for more stable training of a deeper network and the learning of more complex hierarchical features from the RNA sequences.
